summary: Feed s083_single to IDS is degraded: required VLAN 20 is completely missing and 50% of packets are untagged, blinding the IDS to half of required segmented traffic.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or upstream TAP/SPAN trunk is not forwarding VLAN 20 and is stripping 802.1Q tags - 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is absent while VLAN 10 is expected. Most likely a trunk pruning / allowed-VLAN list misconfiguration or a broker policy to strip tags on egress to the 1Gbps IDS port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires both VLANs 10 and 20 with full payload and bidirectional visibility. Missing VLAN 20 eliminates visibility into that segment and untagged delivery prevents VLAN-aware signatures and segmentation policy detection, cutting detection coverage by ~50%.

recommended_fix.why: Configure packet broker ingress/egress to forward trunk with VLANs 10 and 20 intact and preserve 802.1Q tags to the IDS, so the IDS can correctly classify and inspect both segments.
